# Telegram Bot API

> The Bot API is an HTTP-based interface for developing Telegram bots.

Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api

Snapshot of the supplied Markdown, not a live API reference.
Read the relevant section and follow its local type/method links.

## Full reference

- [Complete documentation](llms-full.txt): All API sections in one file.

- [Recent changes](sections/recent-changes.md): Subscribe to @BotNews to be the first to know about the latest updates and join the discussion in @BotTalk
- [August 24, 2026](sections/august-24-2026.md): Bot API 10.3
- [July 14, 2026](sections/july-14-2026.md): Bot API 10.2
- [June 11, 2026](sections/june-11-2026.md): Bot API 10.1
- [May 8, 2026](sections/may-8-2026.md): Bot API 10.0

## Authorizing your bot

- [Authorizing your bot](sections/authorizing-your-bot.md): Each bot is given a unique authentication token when it is created. The token looks something like 123456:ABC-DEF1234ghIkl-zyx57W2v1u123ew11, but we'll use simply \<token\> in this

## Making requests

- [Making requests](sections/making-requests.md): All queries to the Telegram Bot API must be served over HTTPS and need to be presented in this form: https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/METHODNAME. Like this for example:
- [Making requests when getting updates](sections/making-requests-when-getting-updates.md): If you're using webhooks, you can perform a request to the Bot API while sending an answer to the webhook. Use either application/json or application/x-www-form-urlencoded or multi

## Using a Local Bot API Server

- [Using a Local Bot API Server](sections/using-a-local-bot-api-server.md): The Bot API server source code is available at telegram-bot-api. You can run it locally and send the requests to your own server instead of https://api.telegram.org. If you switch 
- [Do I need a Local Bot API Server](sections/do-i-need-a-local-bot-api-server.md): The majority of bots will be OK with the default configuration, running on our servers. But if you feel that you need one of these features, you're welcome to switch to your own at

## Getting updates

- [Getting updates](sections/getting-updates.md): There are two mutually exclusive ways of receiving updates for your bot - the getUpdates method on one hand and webhooks on the other. Incoming updates are stored on the server unt
- [Update](sections/update.md): This object represents an incoming update.
- [getUpdates](sections/getupdates.md): Use this method to receive incoming updates using long polling (wiki). Returns an Array of Update objects.
- [setWebhook](sections/setwebhook.md): Use this method to specify a URL and receive incoming updates via an outgoing webhook. Whenever there is an update for the bot, we will send an HTTPS POST request to the specified 
- [deleteWebhook](sections/deletewebhook.md): Use this method to remove webhook integration if you decide to switch back to getUpdates. Returns True on success.
- [getWebhookInfo](sections/getwebhookinfo.md): Use this method to get current webhook status. Requires no parameters. On success, returns a WebhookInfo object. If the bot is using getUpdates, will return an object with the url 
- [WebhookInfo](sections/webhookinfo.md): Describes the current status of a webhook.

## Available types

- [Available types](sections/available-types.md): All types used in the Bot API responses are represented as JSON-objects.
- [User](sections/user.md): This object represents a Telegram user or bot.
- [Chat](sections/chat.md): This object represents a chat.
- [ChatFullInfo](sections/chatfullinfo.md): This object contains full information about a chat.
- [Message](sections/message.md): This object represents a message.
- [MessageId](sections/messageid.md): This object represents a unique message identifier.
- [InaccessibleMessage](sections/inaccessiblemessage.md): This object describes a message that was deleted or is otherwise inaccessible to the bot.
- [MaybeInaccessibleMessage](sections/maybeinaccessiblemessage.md): This object describes a message that can be inaccessible to the bot. It can be one of
- [MessageEntity](sections/messageentity.md): This object represents one special entity in a text message. For example, hashtags, usernames, URLs, etc.
- [TextQuote](sections/textquote.md): This object contains information about the quoted part of a message that is replied to by the given message.
- [ExternalReplyInfo](sections/externalreplyinfo.md): This object contains information about a message that is being replied to, which may come from another chat or forum topic.
- [ReplyParameters](sections/replyparameters.md): Describes reply parameters for the message that is being sent.
- [EphemeralMessageParameters](sections/ephemeralmessageparameters.md)
- [MessageOrigin](sections/messageorigin.md): This object describes the origin of a message. It can be one of
- [MessageOriginUser](sections/messageoriginuser.md): The message was originally sent by a known user.
- [MessageOriginHiddenUser](sections/messageoriginhiddenuser.md): The message was originally sent by an unknown user.
- [MessageOriginChat](sections/messageoriginchat.md): The message was originally sent on behalf of a chat to a group chat.
- [MessageOriginChannel](sections/messageoriginchannel.md): The message was originally sent to a channel chat.
- [PhotoSize](sections/photosize.md): This object represents one size of a photo or a file / sticker thumbnail.
- [Animation](sections/animation.md): This object represents an animation file (GIF or H.264/MPEG-4 AVC video without sound).
- [Audio](sections/audio.md): This object represents an audio file to be treated as music by the Telegram clients.
- [Document](sections/document.md): This object represents a general file (as opposed to photos, voice messages and audio files).
- [LivePhoto](sections/livephoto.md): This object represents a live photo.
- [Story](sections/story.md): This object represents a story.
- [VideoQuality](sections/videoquality.md): This object represents a video file of a specific quality.
- [Video](sections/video.md): This object represents a video file.
- [VideoNote](sections/videonote.md): This object represents a video message.
- [Voice](sections/voice.md): This object represents a voice note.
- [PaidMediaInfo](sections/paidmediainfo.md): Describes the paid media added to a message.
- [PaidMedia](sections/paidmedia.md): This object describes paid media. Currently, it can be one of
- [PaidMediaLivePhoto](sections/paidmedialivephoto.md): The paid media is a live photo.
- [PaidMediaPhoto](sections/paidmediaphoto.md): The paid media is a photo.
- [PaidMediaPreview](sections/paidmediapreview.md): The paid media isn't available before the payment.
- [PaidMediaVideo](sections/paidmediavideo.md): The paid media is a video.
- [Contact](sections/contact.md): This object represents a phone contact.
- [Dice](sections/dice.md): This object represents an animated emoji that displays a random value.
- [Link](sections/link.md): Represents an HTTP link.
- [PollMedia](sections/pollmedia.md): At most one of the optional fields can be present in any given object.
- [InputPollMedia](sections/inputpollmedia.md): This object represents the content of a poll description or a quiz explanation to be sent. It should be one of
- [InputPollOptionMedia](sections/inputpolloptionmedia.md): This object represents the content of a poll option to be sent. It should be one of
- [PollOption](sections/polloption.md): This object contains information about one answer option in a poll.
- [InputPollOption](sections/inputpolloption.md): This object contains information about one answer option in a poll to be sent.
- [PollAnswer](sections/pollanswer.md): This object represents an answer of a user in a non-anonymous poll.
- [Poll](sections/poll.md): This object contains information about a poll.
- [ChecklistTask](sections/checklisttask.md): Describes a task in a checklist.
- [Checklist](sections/checklist.md): Describes a checklist.
- [InputChecklistTask](sections/inputchecklisttask.md): Describes a task to add to a checklist.
- [InputChecklist](sections/inputchecklist.md): Describes a checklist to create.
- [Location](sections/location.md): This object represents a point on the map.
- [Venue](sections/venue.md): This object represents a venue.
- [WebAppData](sections/webappdata.md): Describes data sent from a Web App to the bot.
- [ProximityAlertTriggered](sections/proximityalerttriggered.md): This object represents the content of a service message, sent whenever a user in the chat triggers a proximity alert set by another user.
- [MessageAutoDeleteTimerChanged](sections/messageautodeletetimerchanged.md): This object represents a service message about a change in auto-delete timer settings.
- [ManagedBotCreated](sections/managedbotcreated.md): This object contains information about the bot that was created to be managed by the current bot.
- [ManagedBotUpdated](sections/managedbotupdated.md): This object contains information about the creation, token update, or owner update of a bot that is managed by the current bot.
- [BotSubscriptionUpdated](sections/botsubscriptionupdated.md): This object contains information about changes to a user payment subscription toward the current bot.
- [MessageGenerationStopped](sections/messagegenerationstopped.md): This object describes an update about a user stopping message generation.
- [PollOptionAdded](sections/polloptionadded.md): Describes a service message about an option added to a poll.
- [PollOptionDeleted](sections/polloptiondeleted.md): Describes a service message about an option deleted from a poll.
- [ChatBoostAdded](sections/chatboostadded.md): This object represents a service message about a user boosting a chat.
- [BackgroundFill](sections/backgroundfill.md): This object describes the way a background is filled based on the selected colors. Currently, it can be one of
- [BackgroundFillSolid](sections/backgroundfillsolid.md): The background is filled using the selected color.
- [BackgroundFillGradient](sections/backgroundfillgradient.md): The background is a gradient fill.
- [BackgroundFillFreeformGradient](sections/backgroundfillfreeformgradient.md): The background is a freeform gradient that rotates after every message in the chat.
- [BackgroundType](sections/backgroundtype.md): This object describes the type of a background. Currently, it can be one of
- [BackgroundTypeFill](sections/backgroundtypefill.md): The background is automatically filled based on the selected colors.
- [BackgroundTypeWallpaper](sections/backgroundtypewallpaper.md): The background is a wallpaper in the JPEG format.
- [BackgroundTypePattern](sections/backgroundtypepattern.md): The background is a.PNG or.TGV (gzipped subset of SVG with MIME type “application/x-tgwallpattern”) pattern to be combined with the background fill chosen by the user.
- [BackgroundTypeChatTheme](sections/backgroundtypechattheme.md): The background is taken directly from a built-in chat theme.
- [ChatBackground](sections/chatbackground.md): This object represents a chat background.
- [ChecklistTasksDone](sections/checklisttasksdone.md): Describes a service message about checklist tasks marked as done or not done.
- [ChecklistTasksAdded](sections/checklisttasksadded.md): Describes a service message about tasks added to a checklist.
- [CommunityChatAdded](sections/communitychatadded.md): Describes a service message about a chat or a bot being added to a community.
- [CommunityChatJoined](sections/communitychatjoined.md): Describes a service message about a chat being joined by a user from a community.
- [CommunityChatRemoved](sections/communitychatremoved.md): Describes a service message about a chat or a bot being removed from a community. Currently holds no information.
- [ForumTopicCreated](sections/forumtopiccreated.md): This object represents a service message about a new forum topic created in the chat.
- [ForumTopicClosed](sections/forumtopicclosed.md): This object represents a service message about a forum topic closed in the chat. Currently holds no information.
- [ForumTopicEdited](sections/forumtopicedited.md): This object represents a service message about an edited forum topic.
- [ForumTopicReopened](sections/forumtopicreopened.md): This object represents a service message about a forum topic reopened in the chat. Currently holds no information.
- [GeneralForumTopicHidden](sections/generalforumtopichidden.md): This object represents a service message about General forum topic hidden in the chat. Currently holds no information.
- [GeneralForumTopicUnhidden](sections/generalforumtopicunhidden.md): This object represents a service message about General forum topic unhidden in the chat. Currently holds no information.
- [SharedUser](sections/shareduser.md): This object contains information about a user that was shared with the bot using a KeyboardButtonRequestUsers button.
- [UsersShared](sections/usersshared.md): This object contains information about the users whose identifiers were shared with the bot using a KeyboardButtonRequestUsers button.
- [ChatShared](sections/chatshared.md): This object contains information about a chat that was shared with the bot using a KeyboardButtonRequestChat button.
- [WriteAccessAllowed](sections/writeaccessallowed.md): This object represents a service message about a user allowing a bot to write messages after adding it to the attachment menu, launching a Web App from a link, or accepting an expl
- [VideoChatScheduled](sections/videochatscheduled.md): This object represents a service message about a video chat scheduled in the chat.
- [VideoChatStarted](sections/videochatstarted.md): This object represents a service message about a video chat started in the chat. Currently holds no information.
- [VideoChatEnded](sections/videochatended.md): This object represents a service message about a video chat ended in the chat.
- [VideoChatParticipantsInvited](sections/videochatparticipantsinvited.md): This object represents a service message about new members invited to a video chat.
- [PaidMessagePriceChanged](sections/paidmessagepricechanged.md): Describes a service message about a change in the price of paid messages within a chat.
- [DirectMessagePriceChanged](sections/directmessagepricechanged.md): Describes a service message about a change in the price of direct messages sent to a channel chat.
- [SuggestedPostApproved](sections/suggestedpostapproved.md): Describes a service message about the approval of a suggested post.
- [SuggestedPostApprovalFailed](sections/suggestedpostapprovalfailed.md): Describes a service message about the failed approval of a suggested post. Currently, only caused by insufficient user funds at the time of approval.
- [SuggestedPostDeclined](sections/suggestedpostdeclined.md): Describes a service message about the rejection of a suggested post.
- [SuggestedPostPaid](sections/suggestedpostpaid.md): Describes a service message about a successful payment for a suggested post.
- [SuggestedPostRefunded](sections/suggestedpostrefunded.md): Describes a service message about a payment refund for a suggested post.
- [GiveawayCreated](sections/giveawaycreated.md): This object represents a service message about the creation of a scheduled giveaway.
- [Giveaway](sections/giveaway.md): This object represents a message about a scheduled giveaway.
- [GiveawayWinners](sections/giveawaywinners.md): This object represents a message about the completion of a giveaway with public winners.
- [GiveawayCompleted](sections/giveawaycompleted.md): This object represents a service message about the completion of a giveaway without public winners.
- [LinkPreviewOptions](sections/linkpreviewoptions.md): Describes the options used for link preview generation.
- [SuggestedPostPrice](sections/suggestedpostprice.md): Describes the price of a suggested post.
- [SuggestedPostInfo](sections/suggestedpostinfo.md): Contains information about a suggested post.
- [SuggestedPostParameters](sections/suggestedpostparameters.md): Contains parameters of a post that is being suggested by the bot.
- [DirectMessagesTopic](sections/directmessagestopic.md): Describes a topic of a direct messages chat.
- [UserProfilePhotos](sections/userprofilephotos.md): This object represent a user's profile pictures.
- [UserProfileAudios](sections/userprofileaudios.md): This object represents the audios displayed on a user's profile.
- [File](sections/file.md): This object represents a file ready to be downloaded. The file can be downloaded via the link https://api.telegram.org/file/bot<token>/<filepath>. It is guaranteed that the link wi
- [WebAppInfo](sections/webappinfo.md): Describes a Web App.
- [ReplyKeyboardMarkup](sections/replykeyboardmarkup.md): This object represents a custom keyboard with reply options (see Introduction to bots for details and examples). Not supported in channels and for messages sent on behalf of a busi
- [KeyboardButton](sections/keyboardbutton.md): This object represents one button of the reply keyboard. At most one of the fields other than text, iconcustomemojiid, and style must be used to specify the type of the button. For
- [KeyboardButtonRequestUsers](sections/keyboardbuttonrequestusers.md): This object defines the criteria used to request suitable users. Information about the selected users will be shared with the bot when the corresponding button is pressed. More abo
- [KeyboardButtonRequestChat](sections/keyboardbuttonrequestchat.md): This object defines the criteria used to request a suitable chat. Information about the selected chat will be shared with the bot when the corresponding button is pressed. The bot 
- [KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot](sections/keyboardbuttonrequestmanagedbot.md): This object defines the parameters for the creation of a managed bot. Information about the created bot will be shared with the bot using the update managedbot and a Message with t
- [KeyboardButtonPollType](sections/keyboardbuttonpolltype.md): This object represents type of a poll, which is allowed to be created and sent when the corresponding button is pressed.
- [ReplyKeyboardRemove](sections/replykeyboardremove.md): Upon receiving a message with this object, Telegram clients will remove the current custom keyboard and display the default letter-keyboard. By default, custom keyboards are displa
- [InlineKeyboardMarkup](sections/inlinekeyboardmarkup.md): This object represents an inline keyboard that appears right next to the message it belongs to.
- [InlineKeyboardButton](sections/inlinekeyboardbutton.md): This object represents one button of an inline keyboard. Exactly one of the fields other than text, iconcustomemojiid, and style must be used to specify the type of the button.
- [LoginUrl](sections/loginurl.md): This object represents a parameter of the inline keyboard button used to automatically authorize a user. It serves as a great replacement for the Telegram Login Widget when the use
- [SwitchInlineQueryChosenChat](sections/switchinlinequerychosenchat.md): This object represents an inline button that switches the current user to inline mode in a chosen chat, with an optional default inline query.
- [CopyTextButton](sections/copytextbutton.md): This object represents an inline keyboard button that copies specified text to the clipboard.
- [DisabledButton](sections/disabledbutton.md): This object represents a disabled button which does nothing. Currently holds no information.
- [CallbackQuery](sections/callbackquery.md): This object represents an incoming callback query from a callback button in an inline keyboard. If the button that originated the query was attached to a message sent by the bot, t
- [ForceReply](sections/forcereply.md): Upon receiving a message with this object, Telegram clients will display a reply interface to the user (act as if the user has selected the bot's message and tapped 'Reply'). This 
- [Community](sections/community.md): Represents a community (a group of chats).
- [ChatPhoto](sections/chatphoto.md): This object represents a chat photo.
- [ChatInviteLink](sections/chatinvitelink.md): Represents an invite link for a chat.
- [ChatAdministratorRights](sections/chatadministratorrights.md): Represents the rights of an administrator in a chat.
- [ChatMemberUpdated](sections/chatmemberupdated.md): This object represents changes in the status of a chat member.
- [ChatMember](sections/chatmember.md): This object contains information about one member of a chat. Currently, the following 6 types of chat members are supported:
- [ChatMemberOwner](sections/chatmemberowner.md): Represents a chat member that owns the chat and has all administrator privileges.
- [ChatMemberAdministrator](sections/chatmemberadministrator.md): Represents a chat member that has some additional privileges.
- [ChatMemberMember](sections/chatmembermember.md): Represents a chat member that has no additional privileges or restrictions.
- [ChatMemberRestricted](sections/chatmemberrestricted.md): Represents a chat member that is under certain restrictions in the chat. Supergroups only.
- [ChatMemberLeft](sections/chatmemberleft.md): Represents a chat member that isn't currently a member of the chat, but may join it themselves.
- [ChatMemberBanned](sections/chatmemberbanned.md): Represents a chat member that was banned in the chat and can't return to the chat or view chat messages.
- [ChatJoinRequest](sections/chatjoinrequest.md): Represents a join request sent to a chat.
- [ChatPermissions](sections/chatpermissions.md): Describes actions that a non-administrator user is allowed to take in a chat.
- [Birthdate](sections/birthdate.md): Describes the birthdate of a user.
- [BusinessIntro](sections/businessintro.md): Contains information about the start page settings of a Telegram Business account.
- [BusinessLocation](sections/businesslocation.md): Contains information about the location of a Telegram Business account.
- [BusinessOpeningHoursInterval](sections/businessopeninghoursinterval.md): Describes an interval of time during which a business is open.
- [BusinessOpeningHours](sections/businessopeninghours.md): Describes the opening hours of a business.
- [UserRating](sections/userrating.md): This object describes the rating of a user based on their Telegram Star spendings.
- [StoryAreaPosition](sections/storyareaposition.md): Describes the position of a clickable area within a story.
- [LocationAddress](sections/locationaddress.md): Describes the physical address of a location.
- [StoryAreaType](sections/storyareatype.md): Describes the type of a clickable area on a story. Currently, it can be one of
- [StoryAreaTypeLocation](sections/storyareatypelocation.md): Describes a story area pointing to a location. Currently, a story can have up to 10 location areas.
- [StoryAreaTypeSuggestedReaction](sections/storyareatypesuggestedreaction.md): Describes a story area pointing to a suggested reaction. Currently, a story can have up to 5 suggested reaction areas.
- [StoryAreaTypeLink](sections/storyareatypelink.md): Describes a story area pointing to an HTTP or tg:// link. Currently, a story can have up to 3 link areas.
- [StoryAreaTypeWeather](sections/storyareatypeweather.md): Describes a story area containing weather information. Currently, a story can have up to 3 weather areas.
- [StoryAreaTypeUniqueGift](sections/storyareatypeuniquegift.md): Describes a story area pointing to a unique gift. Currently, a story can have at most 1 unique gift area.
- [StoryArea](sections/storyarea.md): Describes a clickable area on a story media.
- [ChatLocation](sections/chatlocation.md): Represents a location to which a chat is connected.
- [ReactionType](sections/reactiontype.md): This object describes the type of a reaction. Currently, it can be one of
- [ReactionTypeEmoji](sections/reactiontypeemoji.md): The reaction is based on an emoji.
- [ReactionTypeCustomEmoji](sections/reactiontypecustomemoji.md): The reaction is based on a custom emoji.
- [ReactionTypePaid](sections/reactiontypepaid.md): The reaction is paid.
- [ReactionCount](sections/reactioncount.md): Represents a reaction added to a message along with the number of times it was added.
- [MessageReactionUpdated](sections/messagereactionupdated.md): This object represents a change of a reaction on a message performed by a user.
- [MessageReactionCountUpdated](sections/messagereactioncountupdated.md): This object represents reaction changes on a message with anonymous reactions.
- [ForumTopic](sections/forumtopic.md): This object represents a forum topic.
- [GiftBackground](sections/giftbackground.md): This object describes the background of a gift.
- [Gift](sections/gift.md): This object represents a gift that can be sent by the bot.
- [Gifts](sections/gifts.md): This object represent a list of gifts.
- [UniqueGiftModel](sections/uniquegiftmodel.md): This object describes the model of a unique gift.
- [UniqueGiftSymbol](sections/uniquegiftsymbol.md): This object describes the symbol shown on the pattern of a unique gift.
- [UniqueGiftBackdropColors](sections/uniquegiftbackdropcolors.md): This object describes the colors of the backdrop of a unique gift.
- [UniqueGiftBackdrop](sections/uniquegiftbackdrop.md): This object describes the backdrop of a unique gift.
- [UniqueGiftColors](sections/uniquegiftcolors.md): This object contains information about the color scheme for a user's name, message replies and link previews based on a unique gift.
- [UniqueGift](sections/uniquegift.md): This object describes a unique gift that was upgraded from a regular gift.
- [GiftInfo](sections/giftinfo.md): Describes a service message about a regular gift that was sent or received.
- [UniqueGiftInfo](sections/uniquegiftinfo.md): Describes a service message about a unique gift that was sent or received.
- [OwnedGift](sections/ownedgift.md): This object describes a gift received and owned by a user or a chat. Currently, it can be one of
- [OwnedGiftRegular](sections/ownedgiftregular.md): Describes a regular gift owned by a user or a chat.
- [OwnedGiftUnique](sections/ownedgiftunique.md): Describes a unique gift received and owned by a user or a chat.
- [OwnedGifts](sections/ownedgifts.md): Contains the list of gifts received and owned by a user or a chat.
- [BotAccessSettings](sections/botaccesssettings.md): This object describes the access settings of a bot.
- [AcceptedGiftTypes](sections/acceptedgifttypes.md): This object describes the types of gifts that can be gifted to a user or a chat.
- [StarAmount](sections/staramount.md): Describes an amount of Telegram Stars.
- [BotCommand](sections/botcommand.md): This object represents a bot command.
- [BotCommandScope](sections/botcommandscope.md): This object represents the scope to which bot commands are applied. Currently, the following 7 scopes are supported:
- [Determining list of commands](sections/determining-list-of-commands.md): The following algorithm is used to determine the list of commands for a particular user viewing the bot menu. The first list of commands which is set is returned:
- [BotCommandScopeDefault](sections/botcommandscopedefault.md): Represents the default scope of bot commands. Default commands are used if no commands with a narrower scope are specified for the user.
- [BotCommandScopeAllPrivateChats](sections/botcommandscopeallprivatechats.md): Represents the scope of bot commands, covering all private chats.
- [BotCommandScopeAllGroupChats](sections/botcommandscopeallgroupchats.md): Represents the scope of bot commands, covering all group and supergroup chats.
- [BotCommandScopeAllChatAdministrators](sections/botcommandscopeallchatadministrators.md): Represents the scope of bot commands, covering all group and supergroup chat administrators.
- [BotCommandScopeChat](sections/botcommandscopechat.md): Represents the scope of bot commands, covering a specific chat.
- [BotCommandScopeChatAdministrators](sections/botcommandscopechatadministrators.md): Represents the scope of bot commands, covering all administrators of a specific group or supergroup chat.
- [BotCommandScopeChatMember](sections/botcommandscopechatmember.md): Represents the scope of bot commands, covering a specific member of a group or supergroup chat.
- [BotName](sections/botname.md): This object represents the bot's name.
- [BotDescription](sections/botdescription.md): This object represents the bot's description.
- [BotShortDescription](sections/botshortdescription.md): This object represents the bot's short description.
- [MenuButton](sections/menubutton.md): This object describes the bot's menu button in a private chat. It should be one of
- [MenuButtonCommands](sections/menubuttoncommands.md): Represents a menu button, which opens the bot's list of commands.
- [MenuButtonWebApp](sections/menubuttonwebapp.md): Represents a menu button, which launches a Web App.
- [MenuButtonDefault](sections/menubuttondefault.md): Describes that no specific value for the menu button was set.
- [ChatBoostSource](sections/chatboostsource.md): This object describes the source of a chat boost. It can be one of
- [ChatBoostSourcePremium](sections/chatboostsourcepremium.md): The boost was obtained by subscribing to Telegram Premium or by gifting a Telegram Premium subscription to another user.
- [ChatBoostSourceGiftCode](sections/chatboostsourcegiftcode.md): The boost was obtained by the creation of Telegram Premium gift codes to boost a chat. Each such code boosts the chat 4 times for the duration of the corresponding Telegram Premium
- [ChatBoostSourceGiveaway](sections/chatboostsourcegiveaway.md): The boost was obtained by the creation of a Telegram Premium or a Telegram Star giveaway. This boosts the chat 4 times for the duration of the corresponding Telegram Premium subscr
- [ChatBoost](sections/chatboost.md): This object contains information about a chat boost.
- [ChatBoostUpdated](sections/chatboostupdated.md): This object represents a boost added to a chat or changed.
- [ChatBoostRemoved](sections/chatboostremoved.md): This object represents a boost removed from a chat.
- [ChatOwnerLeft](sections/chatownerleft.md): Describes a service message about the chat owner leaving the chat.
- [ChatOwnerChanged](sections/chatownerchanged.md): Describes a service message about an ownership change in the chat.
- [UserChatBoosts](sections/userchatboosts.md): This object represents a list of boosts added to a chat by a user.
- [BusinessBotRights](sections/businessbotrights.md): Represents the rights of a business bot.
- [BusinessConnection](sections/businessconnection.md): Describes the connection of the bot with a business account.
- [BusinessMessagesDeleted](sections/businessmessagesdeleted.md): This object is received when messages are deleted from a connected business account.
- [SentWebAppMessage](sections/sentwebappmessage.md): Describes an inline message sent by a Web App on behalf of a user.
- [SentGuestMessage](sections/sentguestmessage.md): Describes an inline message sent by a guest bot.
- [PreparedInlineMessage](sections/preparedinlinemessage.md): Describes an inline message to be sent by a user of a Mini App.
- [PreparedKeyboardButton](sections/preparedkeyboardbutton.md): Describes a keyboard button to be used by a user of a Mini App.
- [ResponseParameters](sections/responseparameters.md): Describes why a request was unsuccessful.
- [InputMedia](sections/inputmedia.md): This object represents the content of a media message to be sent. It should be one of
- [InputMediaAnimation](sections/inputmediaanimation.md): Represents an animation file (GIF or H.264/MPEG-4 AVC video without sound) to be sent.
- [InputMediaAudio](sections/inputmediaaudio.md): Represents an audio file to be treated as music to be sent.
- [InputMediaDocument](sections/inputmediadocument.md): Represents a general file to be sent.
- [InputMediaLink](sections/inputmedialink.md): Represents an HTTP link to be sent.
- [InputMediaLivePhoto](sections/inputmedialivephoto.md): Represents a live photo to be sent.

- [InputMediaVideo](sections/inputmediavideo.md): Represents a video to be sent.
- [InputMediaVoiceNote](sections/inputmediavoicenote.md): Represents a voice message file to be sent.

- [InputPaidMedia](sections/inputpaidmedia.md): This object describes the paid media to be sent. Currently, it can be one of
- [InputPaidMediaLivePhoto](sections/inputpaidmedialivephoto.md): The paid media to send is a live photo.
- [InputPaidMediaPhoto](sections/inputpaidmediaphoto.md): The paid media to send is a photo.
- [InputPaidMediaVideo](sections/inputpaidmediavideo.md): The paid media to send is a video.
- [InputProfilePhoto](sections/inputprofilephoto.md): This object describes a profile photo to set. Currently, it can be one of
- [InputProfilePhotoStatic](sections/inputprofilephotostatic.md): A static profile photo in the.JPG format.
- [InputProfilePhotoAnimated](sections/inputprofilephotoanimated.md): An animated profile photo in the MPEG4 format.
- [InputStoryContent](sections/inputstorycontent.md): This object describes the content of a story to post. Currently, it can be one of
- [InputStoryContentPhoto](sections/inputstorycontentphoto.md): Describes a photo to post as a story.
- [InputStoryContentVideo](sections/inputstorycontentvideo.md): Describes a video to post as a story.

- [getMe](sections/getme.md): A simple method for testing your bot's authentication token. Requires no parameters. Returns basic information about the bot in form of a User object.

- [close](sections/close.md): Use this method to close the bot instance before moving it from one local server to another. You need to delete the webhook before calling this method to ensure that the bot isn't 
- [sendMessage](sections/sendmessage.md): Use this method to send text messages. On success, the sent Message is returned.
- [Formatting options](sections/formatting-options.md): The Bot API supports basic formatting for messages. You can use bold, italic, underlined, strikethrough, spoiler text, block quotations as well as inline links and pre-formatted co
- [Ephemeral Messages and Commands](sections/ephemeral-messages-and-commands.md): Ephemeral interactions allow a bot and an individual member of a group or supergroup chat to communicate privately on the public timeline without cluttering the chat for other memb
- [Paid Broadcasts](sections/paid-broadcasts.md): By default, all bots are able to broadcast up to 30 messages per second to their users. Developers can increase this limit by enabling Paid Broadcasts in @BotFather - allowing thei
- [forwardMessage](sections/forwardmessage.md): Use this method to forward messages of any kind. Service messages and messages with protected content can't be forwarded. On success, the sent Message is returned.

- [sendPhoto](sections/sendphoto.md): Use this method to send photos. On success, the sent Message is returned.
- [sendLivePhoto](sections/sendlivephoto.md): Use this method to send live photos. On success, the sent Message is returned.

- [editEphemeralMessageReplyMarkup](sections/editephemeralmessagereplymarkup.md): Use this method to edit only the reply markup of an ephemeral message. Note that it is not guaranteed that the user will receive the message edit event, especially if they are offl
- [approveSuggestedPost](sections/approvesuggestedpost.md): Use this method to approve a suggested post in a direct messages chat. The bot must have the 'canpostmessages' administrator right in the corresponding channel chat. Returns True o
- [declineSuggestedPost](sections/declinesuggestedpost.md): Use this method to decline a suggested post in a direct messages chat. The bot must have the 'canmanagedirectmessages' administrator right in the corresponding channel chat. Return
- [deleteMessage](sections/deletemessage.md): Use this method to delete a message, including service messages, with the following limitations:
- [deleteMessages](sections/deletemessages.md): Use this method to delete multiple messages simultaneously. If some of the specified messages can't be found, they are skipped. Returns True on success.
- [deleteEphemeralMessage](sections/deleteephemeralmessage.md): Use this method to delete an ephemeral message. Note that it is not guaranteed that the user will receive the message deletion event, especially if they are offline. Returns True o
- [deleteMessageReaction](sections/deletemessagereaction.md): Use this method to remove a reaction from a message in a group or a supergroup chat. The bot must have the 'candeletemessages' administrator right in the chat. Returns True on succ
- [deleteAllMessageReactions](sections/deleteallmessagereactions.md): Use this method to remove up to 10000 recent reactions in a group or a supergroup chat added by a given user or chat. The bot must have the 'candeletemessages' administrator right 

## Stickers

- [Stickers](sections/stickers.md): The following methods and objects allow your bot to handle stickers and sticker sets.
- [Sticker](sections/sticker.md): This object represents a sticker.
- [StickerSet](sections/stickerset.md): This object represents a sticker set.
- [MaskPosition](sections/maskposition.md): This object describes the position on faces where a mask should be placed by default.
- [InputSticker](sections/inputsticker.md): This object describes a sticker to be added to a sticker set.
- [sendSticker](sections/sendsticker.md): Use this method to send static.WEBP, animated.TGS, or video.WEBM stickers. On success, the sent Message is returned.
- [getStickerSet](sections/getstickerset.md): Use this method to get a sticker set. On success, a StickerSet object is returned.
- [getCustomEmojiStickers](sections/getcustomemojistickers.md): Use this method to get information about custom emoji stickers by their identifiers. Returns an Array of Sticker objects.
- [uploadStickerFile](sections/uploadstickerfile.md): Use this method to upload a file with a sticker for later use in the createNewStickerSet, addStickerToSet, or replaceStickerInSet methods (the file can be used multiple times). Ret
- [createNewStickerSet](sections/createnewstickerset.md): Use this method to create a new sticker set owned by a user. The bot will be able to edit the sticker set thus created. Returns True on success.
- [addStickerToSet](sections/addstickertoset.md): Use this method to add a new sticker to a set created by the bot. Emoji sticker sets can have up to 200 stickers. Other sticker sets can have up to 120 stickers. Returns True on su
- [setStickerPositionInSet](sections/setstickerpositioninset.md): Use this method to move a sticker in a set created by the bot to a specific position. Returns True on success.
- [deleteStickerFromSet](sections/deletestickerfromset.md): Use this method to delete a sticker from a set created by the bot. Returns True on success.
- [replaceStickerInSet](sections/replacestickerinset.md): Use this method to replace an existing sticker in a sticker set with a new one. The method is equivalent to calling deleteStickerFromSet, then addStickerToSet, then setStickerPosit
- [setStickerEmojiList](sections/setstickeremojilist.md): Use this method to change the list of emoji assigned to a regular or custom emoji sticker. The sticker must belong to a sticker set created by the bot. Returns True on success.
- [setStickerKeywords](sections/setstickerkeywords.md): Use this method to change search keywords assigned to a regular or custom emoji sticker. The sticker must belong to a sticker set created by the bot. Returns True on success.
- [setStickerMaskPosition](sections/setstickermaskposition.md): Use this method to change the mask position of a mask sticker. The sticker must belong to a sticker set that was created by the bot. Returns True on success.
- [setStickerSetTitle](sections/setstickersettitle.md): Use this method to set the title of a created sticker set. Returns True on success.
- [setStickerSetThumbnail](sections/setstickersetthumbnail.md): Use this method to set the thumbnail of a regular or mask sticker set. The format of the thumbnail file must match the format of the stickers in the set. Returns True on success.
- [setCustomEmojiStickerSetThumbnail](sections/setcustomemojistickersetthumbnail.md): Use this method to set the thumbnail of a custom emoji sticker set. Returns True on success.
- [deleteStickerSet](sections/deletestickerset.md): Use this method to delete a sticker set that was created by the bot. Returns True on success.

- [RichBlockPullQuotation](sections/richblockpullquotation.md): A quotation with centered text, loosely corresponding to the HTML tag <aside>.

- [RichBlockSlideshow](sections/richblockslideshow.md): A slideshow, corresponding to the custom HTML tag <tg-slideshow>.
- [RichBlockTable](sections/richblocktable.md): A table, corresponding to the HTML tag <table>.
- [RichBlockDetails](sections/richblockdetails.md): An expandable block for details disclosure, corresponding to the HTML tag <details>.
- [RichBlockMap](sections/richblockmap.md): A block with a map, corresponding to the custom HTML tag <tg-map>.
- [RichBlockButtons](sections/richblockbuttons.md): A block containing a list of buttons that are shown in one row, corresponding to the custom HTML tag <tg-button-row>.
- [RichBlockAnimation](sections/richblockanimation.md): A block with an animation, corresponding to the HTML tag <video>.
- [RichBlockAudio](sections/richblockaudio.md): A block with a music file, corresponding to the HTML tag <audio>.
- [RichBlockDocument](sections/richblockdocument.md): A block with a general file, corresponding to the custom HTML tag <tg-document>.
- [RichBlockPhoto](sections/richblockphoto.md): A block with a photo, corresponding to the HTML tag <img>.
- [RichBlockVideo](sections/richblockvideo.md): A block with a video, corresponding to the HTML tag <video>.
- [RichBlockVoiceNote](sections/richblockvoicenote.md): A block with a voice note, corresponding to the HTML tag <audio>.

- [InputRichBlockListItem](sections/inputrichblocklistitem.md): An item of a list to be sent.

## Telegram Passport

- [Telegram Passport](sections/telegram-passport.md): Telegram Passport is a unified authorization method for services that require personal identification. Users can upload their documents once, then instantly share their data with s
- [PassportData](sections/passportdata.md): Describes Telegram Passport data shared with the bot by the user.
- [PassportFile](sections/passportfile.md): This object represents a file uploaded to Telegram Passport. Currently all Telegram Passport files are in JPEG format when decrypted and don't exceed 10MB.
- [EncryptedPassportElement](sections/encryptedpassportelement.md): Describes documents or other Telegram Passport elements shared with the bot by the user.
- [EncryptedCredentials](sections/encryptedcredentials.md): Describes data required for decrypting and authenticating EncryptedPassportElement. See the Telegram Passport Documentation for a complete description of the data decryption and au
- [setPassportDataErrors](sections/setpassportdataerrors.md): Informs a user that some of the Telegram Passport elements they provided contains errors. The user will not be able to re-submit their Passport to you until the errors are fixed (t
- [PassportElementError](sections/passportelementerror.md): This object represents an error in the Telegram Passport element which was submitted that should be resolved by the user. It should be one of:
- [PassportElementErrorDataField](sections/passportelementerrordatafield.md): Represents an issue in one of the data fields that was provided by the user. The error is considered resolved when the field's value changes.
- [PassportElementErrorFrontSide](sections/passportelementerrorfrontside.md): Represents an issue with the front side of a document. The error is considered resolved when the file with the front side of the document changes.
- [PassportElementErrorReverseSide](sections/passportelementerrorreverseside.md): Represents an issue with the reverse side of a document. The error is considered resolved when the file with reverse side of the document changes.
- [PassportElementErrorSelfie](sections/passportelementerrorselfie.md): Represents an issue with the selfie with a document. The error is considered resolved when the file with the selfie changes.
- [PassportElementErrorFile](sections/passportelementerrorfile.md): Represents an issue with a document scan. The error is considered resolved when the file with the document scan changes.
- [PassportElementErrorFiles](sections/passportelementerrorfiles.md): Represents an issue with a list of scans. The error is considered resolved when the list of files containing the scans changes.
- [PassportElementErrorTranslationFile](sections/passportelementerrortranslationfile.md): Represents an issue with one of the files that constitute the translation of a document. The error is considered resolved when the file changes.
- [PassportElementErrorTranslationFiles](sections/passportelementerrortranslationfiles.md): Represents an issue with the translated version of a document. The error is considered resolved when a file with the document translation change.
- [PassportElementErrorUnspecified](sections/passportelementerrorunspecified.md): Represents an issue in an unspecified place. The error is considered resolved when new data is added.

## Games

- [Games](sections/games.md): Your bot can offer users HTML5 games to play solo or to compete against each other in groups and one-on-one chats. Create games via @BotFather using the /newgame command. Please no
- [sendGame](sections/sendgame.md): Use this method to send a game. On success, the sent Message is returned.
- [Game](sections/game.md): This object represents a game. Use BotFather to create and edit games, their short names will act as unique identifiers.
- [CallbackGame](sections/callbackgame.md): A placeholder, currently holds no information. Use BotFather to set up your game.
- [setGameScore](sections/setgamescore.md): Use this method to set the score of the specified user in a game message. On success, if the message is not an inline message, the Message is returned, otherwise True is returned. 
- [getGameHighScores](sections/getgamehighscores.md): Use this method to get data for high score tables. Will return the score of the specified user and several of their neighbors in a game. Returns an Array of GameHighScore objects.
- [GameHighScore](sections/gamehighscore.md): This object represents one row of the high scores table for a game.
